name: mirage
text: Understood. The one odd thing I saw: that key's bar on your phone says 43,623 left ('counted here', the phone's own estimate), while ParlayAPI's own figure that the engine reads says 72,040 left. I've noted it as a meter bug to fix (the bar should show ParlayAPI's own figure). On waste: the biggest avoidable ParlayAPI cost is reading NFL lines and props on days with no NFL slate (3 credits a call); that cut is queued with the session doing the API audit, so we don't collide.
